column1: # matchup model M0: card power in logits per copy, relative to the average nonland card of the committed cubes
# points = power x 25 (win-rate points at even odds); sdPost = the Laplace posterior SD (D342: use this one);
# sdBoot = SD over refits on bootstrap resamples of the training DRAFTS (a misspecification check: it understates the
# uncertainty of a shrunk estimate, most for the least-seen cards); prior = what the features alone predict;
# ai = limited: Forge's AI:RemoveDeck:All, NOT RATED -- power is its feature prior, never a verdict (D343); random: AI:RemoveDeck:Random.
# games = games with the card in exactly one deck. tau 0.06, tauW 0.003, 48202 games.
